# robinhood-chain-cli

> The command-line toolkit for Robinhood Chain: instant reads with zero config, guarded writes with a wallet. The gh/vercel of Robinhood Chain. npm: hood-cli.

robinhood-chain-cli is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
